Ecliptic Defence and Space is your trusted partner in the development of defence and space components and subsystems utilizing RF and microwave technologies. The engineers at Ecliptic Defence and Space, have decades of experience in all of the RF and Microwave technologies. Their domains of expertise range from component-level to subsystem-level designs, from low power to high-power devices, from passive to active microwave integrated assemblies and from planar to waveguide-based systems and antennas. In a fast globalizing world where rising urban populations concentrate in always larger metropolitan cities, transport has become a major issue for mankind. As demand for transport continues to grow year on year, railway operators have to disrupt the mobility offer while addressing pollution, congestion and security issues. Rail transport is not just a market of the future, it is vital for quality of life. Given the challenges of climate change and the urgent need for regional, social and economic development, we must continue to act. SNCF – as well as the men and women we employ – has both the resources and the commitment to deliver. 
SNCF missions rely in delivering seamless, reliable and environmental-friendly passenger and freight transport, thereby contributing to develop tomorrow’s mobility. The implementation of the French rail reform (pursuant to law n°2018-515 of June 27th 2018) on January 1st 2020 reorganized the SNCF group in 5 fully-state-owned limited liability companies representing an industrial services group:
- The SNCF holding company ensures the Group's long-term strategic and financial management. It comprises the General Directorate for Technologies and its Technology, Innovation and Corporate Projects Division in charge of developing and monitoring R&D activities on behalf of the whole group.
- SNCF Voyageurs (owned by the holding company, formerly “SNCF Mobilités”) comprises all the group’s subsidiaries dedicated to passengers transport worldwide and associated rolling stock assets’ engineering and maintenance.
- SNCF Réseau (owned by the holding company) is a railway infrastructure manager in charge of engineering, operating and maintaining the French rail network. 
- SNCF Gares & Connexions (subsidiary of SNCF Réseau) manages and operates French train stations. It ensures efficient train station access and services for transport operators. 
- SNCF Fret is the leading French freight transport operator.

ORCA Computing is a startup based in London with a mission to build full-stack, photonic quantum computers. ORCA’s multidisciplinary team of quantum scientists, engineers and mathematicians are developing unique hardware and architectures to completely change the face of high-performance computing and networking, from near-term quantum devices and applications to universal, fault-tolerant quantum systems.
ORCA’s employees have previously worked and held leadership positions at public institutions such as Innovate UK, Oxford University and Imperial College London, and companies such as Teledyne E2V, TTP, Xanadu and Cray.
ORCA’s technical approach emerged from 35 years of research leadership by Professor Ian Walmsley (now Chairman of the ORCA board of directors, and Provost of Imperial College), and his Ultrafast Quantum Optics Group at the University of Oxford (UK), giving ORCA a significant knowledge base and experience across the fields of quantum optics, atomic physics, error correction, AI and optical networks. Since forming ORCA, the company has built on that experience, and combined that with an industry-oriented leadership team to deliver commercially relevant quantum computing systems. This is backed by a large number of high impact publications (see table below) and patents co-authored by our employees, across the fields of quantum optics, atomic physics, error correction, machine learning, high-speed electronics and optical networking.

The Terminology/KM division takes on projects for managing/creating knowledge sharing spaces (Wikis or community portals) and terminology resources for optimising documentation retrieval, indexing and classification systems. We also design professional knowledge transfer modules (for handovers following retirement or changes in job positions, for example).

Development of termino-ontological resources
Technology watch and information and documentation management:
- Information searching and text-mining
- Semantic search engines
- Categorisation (automatic addition of metadata) / documentation classification
- Knowledge structuring and collaborative spaces
Méthodology
Process of acquiring knowledge from documents (linguistic corpus) that are representative of the field/profession in question:
– Terminology extraction
– Clustering
– Development of semantic networks
– Modelling of semantic networks in the form of thesauri or ontologies
Validation by several experts in the field is an integral part of the process.
Knowledge modelling and transfer
For any company, when an employee leaves (on retirement, or by changing jobs, or being promoted elsewhere), there is often a loss of know-how, knowledge, information in general and hence of efficiency for the company. The ideal solution consists in setting up a transition pair, the replacement employee and the future ex-employee, who work together for several months so that the former can learn from the latter.
However, this is not always possible :
- For financial reasons, when the company has to pay two employees for a single job for an extended period of time;
- Or when, due to lack of resources, the replacement employee is not always available for this coaching work, or if no one has yet been chosen to replace the leaving employee; in some cases, fellow employees will temporarily handle the leaver’s tasks.
Our offer
Our intervention involves several stages before the employee leaves :
- Auditing, sorting, classifying and enhancing the value of documentation
- Gathering information from the leaver about his/her specialised knowledge, skills, techniques networks, etc.
- Gathering information from the working community on their perception of the leaver’s competence that they will most miss when the person leaves.
- Modelling the information collected so that it can be made available to the replacement person or to a community.

description: Despite all the wearables and related devices available to consumers, they don’t really know if they are reaching goals to improve their health conditions, wellness, fitness, nutrition, and recovery. The problem is that simply tracking vitals like pulse and movement don’t get at our underlying health states. Repeated blood tests and other invasive lab diagnostics can produce more clarity, but with associated cost, pain, and inconvenience. ViBo Health solves this problem by directly, non-invasively, measuring key blood and tissue biomarkers. We are developing a table-top metabolite scanner to help everyone track their health with actionable guidance provided on a dashboard. Using ESA technology to enhance the sensitivity of magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) antenna, makes this approach viable. Our dashboard will provide an overall health score that can be easily tracked, and metrics for health states like cholesterol, obesity factors, glucose, fitness & recovery condition, even cardiac biomarkers.
